requirement.description: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method has incorrect handling of generators, particularly when dealing with yield from operations and nested computations. The current implementation doesn't properly process generators and fails to correctly handle the flow control between nested computations.
requirement.contract: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method must properly execute generators and handle yield from operations, ensuring that nested computations are correctly processed and combined according to the computational expression semantics.

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method incorrectly processes generator sends and returns, causing it to return None instead of proper values for many test cases.
requirement.contract: The SeqBuilder.__call__ method must correctly handle generator execution flow including proper sending of values to generators and collecting yielded values to return them as sequences.

requirement.description: The AsyncOptionBuilder.__call__ method has incorrect handling of generators, particularly in the way it processes yields and handles the generator lifecycle. Many tests are failing due to incorrect value handling.
requirement.contract: The AsyncOptionBuilder.__call__ method must properly execute async generators and handle yield operations correctly, ensuring that the computational expression semantics are properly implemented.

requirement.description: The AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method has incorrect handling of generators and async operations, particularly around handling of return values and error propagation.
requirement.contract: The AsyncResultBuilder.__call__ method must properly execute async generators and handle return values and exceptions correctly according to the computational expression semantics.

requirement.description: The OptionBuilder.__call__ method has incorrect handling of generators, particularly around yield from and return value processing.
requirement.contract: The OptionBuilder.__call__ method must properly execute generators and handle yield operations correctly, ensuring that the computational expression semantics are properly implemented.
